sql:
SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 3 AND toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS q3_sales,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 4 AND toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS q4_sales,
    q4_sales - q3_sales AS sales_change,
    round((q4_sales - q3_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(q3_sales, 0), 2) AS pct_change
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  AND toQuarter(f.DateKey) IN (3, 4)
GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName
HAVING q3_sales > 0
   AND q4_sales < q3_sales
ORDER BY pct_change ASC
